title: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
title_zh: PVBench：基于物体级物理测量量化视频生成的物理合理性

paragraphs.en: Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench , a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains , spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频生成模型能够产出视觉上颇具吸引力的结果，但其物理合理性仍然缺乏充分的衡量。 物理合理性关注的是生成的物体是否遵循几何、运动学、动力学以及守恒定律。 现有基准或依赖粗粒度的视觉-语言模型判断，或面向具身世界模型而非视频生成本身。 我们提出 PVBench，这是一个物理视频基准，通过组织在七个领域中、共 46 个维度的指标，定量衡量生成视频的合理性，涵盖：i) 指令与语义保真度，ii) 行为与因果一致性，iii) 感知与时序质量，iv) 几何与空间一致性，v) 材料属性与场状态，vi) 运动学与时空持续性，vii) 以及机械合理性与守恒定律。 PVBench 包含 600 个精心设计的提示词，其中 30% 涉及物理具身智能体，如机械臂、人形机器人、四足机器人以及多智能体系统。 对于具有挑战性且物理上可求解的维度，基准为其配备专门的视觉模型，以推导可验证、有物理依据的测量结果，例如物体级 6D 位姿、度量尺度、表面法线、运动学以及数值化的守恒定律残差。 由此，它避免了对主观打分的完全依赖，同时支持文本生成视频和图像生成视频两种方式。 最后，我们通过人工评估验证了自动指标与人类判断之间的一致性。 同时，我们评估了主流的开源与闭源模型，并提出了若干见解。 通过发布该基准、提示词和校准协议，我们旨在推动具有物理依据的视频生成。

paragraphs.en: Video generation technology has advanced rapidly in recent years. Large-scale Text-/Image-to-Video (T2V/I2V) models can now produce visually convincing videos and are increasingly regarded as an important foundation for world models [ 20 , 48 ] . Yet looking real does not equal obeying physical laws [ 32 ] : generated videos still frequently exhibit objects clipping through each other, vanishing out of nowhere, or wrong scales. For embodied intelligence [ 33 ] , content creation [ 4 ] , and simulation [ 5 ] , such physical errors directly undermine usability. Therefore, how to measure the physical plausibility of generated videos is a question that video generation must answer before reaching downstream applications.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成技术在近年来取得了快速进展。 大规模的文生视频/图生视频（T2V/I2V）模型如今能够生成视觉上令人信服的视频，并日益被视为世界模型的重要基础 [ 20 , 48 ] 。 然而看起来真实并不等于遵循物理定律 [ 32 ] ：生成的视频仍然经常出现物体相互穿插、凭空消失或比例错误等问题。 对于具身智能 [ 33 ] 、内容创作 [ 4 ] 和仿真 [ 5 ] 而言，这类物理错误直接损害了可用性。 因此，如何度量生成视频的物理合理性，是视频生成技术在走向下游应用之前必须回答的问题。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks still cannot answer this question well. General-purpose video benchmarks [ 16 , 17 ] mainly assess semantic and perceptual quality; a video that seriously violates physical laws can still score high on these metrics as long as the picture is clear and aligned with the text. Benchmarks targeting physical plausibility have two limitations: 1) Semantic binary judgment : most works [ 2 , 14 ] rely on MLLM or human yes/no ratings, which cannot localize which physical quantity is violated, which object violates physics, let alone quantify the severity of the violation; 2) Insufficient physical-quantity coverage : existing evaluation sets usually cover only a few commonsense categories or geometric quantities in simple scenarios, yet some object-level physical quantities are crucial for downstream applications. For example, metric scale determines whether a generated video can support robot manipulation and scene reconstruction that require real dimensions, and 6D pose is the interface quantity from “watching a video” to “using a video” for motion planning and simulation initialization, which is essentially missing in existing works. Recent works have shown the trend of physical-quantity evaluation: Physics-IQ [ 32 ] indirectly characterizes motion with proxy metrics, WorldScore [ 10 ] introduces geometric measurement, but neither is yet a systematic physical-quantity evaluation framework.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试仍然无法很好地回答这个问题。 通用视频基准 [16, 17] 主要评估语义与感知质量；只要画面清晰且与文本一致，即使一段视频严重违反物理定律，仍可在这些指标上获得高分。 针对物理合理性的基准存在两个局限：1) 语义二值判断：大多数工作 [2, 14] 依赖多模态大模型或人工的“是/否”评分，无法定位违反了哪个物理量、哪个物体违反了物理规律，更无法量化违反的严重程度；2) 物理量覆盖不足：现有评测集通常仅覆盖简单场景中的少数常识类别或几何量，然而某些物体级物理量对下游应用至关重要。 例如，度量尺度决定了生成的视频能否支持需要真实尺寸的机器人操作与场景重建，而六维位姿是从“观看视频”到“使用视频”、用于运动规划与仿真初始化的接口量，但在现有工作中基本缺失。 近期工作已显示出物理量评估的趋势：Physics-IQ [32] 通过代理指标间接刻画运动，WorldScore [10] 引入了几何测量，但二者尚未形成系统性的物理量评估框架。

paragraphs.en: We argue that physical plausibility should not stay at the level of semantic impression, but should be implemented as computable physical quantities and tested against physical laws . To this end, this paper proposes PVBench, a physical-plausibility benchmark for video generation models. Its contributions are threefold: 1) Systematic physical taxonomy : it organizes 46 evaluation dimensions into 7 domains, of which 25 physical dimensions span object-intrinsic properties, relations between objects and space, and object dynamics across space and time, covering most physical dimensions that have appeared in existing benchmarks; 2) Same-scene T2V/I2V paired prompt set : 600 prompt groups, each containing T2V/I2V versions of the same scene, 30% of which involve embodied-agent scenarios, and each prompt binds its target evaluation dimensions at construction time and requires the key physical quantities to be visible in the frame; 3) Physical-quantity-dominated evaluation protocol : specialized vision models extract numerical physical quantities, which are checked against physical laws and then mapped to evaluation scores, while dimensions that cannot be directly computed ( e.g. , materials, phase change, etc. ) are supplemented by MLLM scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，物理合理性不应停留在语义印象层面，而应实现为可计算的物理量，并依据物理定律加以检验。 为此，本文提出 PVBench，一个面向视频生成模型的物理合理性基准。 其贡献有三：1) 系统的物理分类体系：它将 46 个评估维度组织为 7 个领域，其中 25 个物理维度涵盖物体自身属性、物体与空间的关系、以及物体在空间和时间中的动态，覆盖了现有基准中出现过的绝大多数物理维度；2) 同场景 T2V/I2V 成对提示词集：共 600 组提示词，每组包含同一场景的 T2V/I2V 版本，其中 30% 涉及具身智能体场景，且每个提示词在构建时即绑定其目标评估维度，并要求关键物理量在画面中可见；3) 以物理量主导的评估协议：由专用视觉模型提取数值物理量，依据物理定律进行检验后再映射为评估分数，而对于无法直接计算的维度（例如材质、相变等），则以 MLLM 打分作为补充。

paragraphs.en: Experiments show that the physical dimensions of PVBench are generally consistent with human judgments. Meanwhile, across 6 T2V and 6 I2V mainstream model configurations, the physical-layer scores are substantially lower overall than those in the semantic and perceptual layers, highlighting a persistent gap in physical plausibility. We will open-source the code and release the prompt set to foster physically grounded video generation research. We hope PVBench can push video generation from “looking good” to “physically usable”.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，PVBench 的物理维度评分与人类判断总体一致。 同时，在 6 种 T2V 和 6 种 I2V 主流模型配置上，物理层得分总体上明显低于语义层和感知层，凸显了物理合理性方面持续存在的差距。 我们将开源代码并发布提示词集，以推动具有物理基础的视频生成研究。 我们希望 PVBench 能推动视频生成从“好看”走向“物理上可用”。

paragraphs.en: Video generation has advanced rapidly under the diffusion paradigm [ 15 , 42 ] , with diffusion transformers [ 36 ] and flow matching [ 24 , 25 ] as the dominant architectural and training choices. Systems such as Sora [ 4 ] , Wan [ 46 ] , and HunyuanVideo 1.5 [ 51 ] now produce high-fidelity T2V and image-to-video (I2V) clips at scale, while recent models further diversify the design space. Seedance 2.0 [ 45 ] unifies text, image, audio, and video inputs in a single model, SANA-Video [ 8 ] pursues efficient long-video generation with linear attention, and MAGI-1 [ 48 ] departs from diffusion altogether to explore autoregressive video generation. Beyond media synthesis, video generators are increasingly framed as world models [ 20 ] . Cosmos [ 33 ] builds world foundation models as digital twins of the physical world for physical AI, while interactive systems accept action inputs, ranging from latent-action environments [ 5 ] to open-domain action-controlled game generation [ 54 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散范式[15, 42]下，视频生成已取得快速进展，扩散Transformer[36]和流匹配[24, 25]成为主流的架构与训练选择。 诸如Sora[4]、Wan[46]和HunyuanVideo 1.5[51]等系统如今已能大规模生成高保真的文生视频（T2V）和图生视频（I2V）片段，而近期的模型则进一步拓展了设计空间。 Seedance 2.0[45]在单一模型中统一了文本、图像、音频和视频输入，SANA-Video[8]借助线性注意力追求高效的长视频生成，而MAGI-1[48]则完全脱离扩散方法，探索自回归视频生成。 在媒体合成之外，视频生成器正日益被定位为世界模型[20]。 Cosmos[33]构建作为物理世界数字孪生的世界基础模型以服务于物理AI，而交互式系统则接受动作输入，范围涵盖从潜在动作环境[5]到开放域动作控制的游戏生成[54]。

sents.zh: Seedance 2.0[45]在单一模型中统一了文本、图像、音频和视频输入，SANA-Video[8]借助线性注意力追求高效的长视频生成，而MAGI-1[48]则完全脱离扩散方法，探索自回归视频生成。

sents.en: Beyond media synthesis, video generators are increasingly framed as world models [ 20 ] .
sents.zh: 在媒体合成之外，视频生成器正日益被定位为世界模型[20]。

sents.en: Cosmos [ 33 ] builds world foundation models as digital twins of the physical world for physical AI, while interactive systems accept action inputs, ranging from latent-action environments [ 5 ] to open-domain action-controlled game generation [ 54 ] .
sents.zh: Cosmos[33]构建作为物理世界数字孪生的世界基础模型以服务于物理AI，而交互式系统则接受动作输入，范围涵盖从潜在动作环境[5]到开放域动作控制的游戏生成[54]。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose suites decompose video quality into perceptual and semantic metrics computed with pretrained perception models or MLLMs as judges. VBench and VBench++ [ 16 , 17 ] cover temporal consistency, motion smoothness, and text-video alignment, while EvalCrafter [ 26 ] and T2V-CompBench [ 44 ] aggregate human-preference and compositional-alignment metrics. VBench-2.0 [ 56 ] moves toward intrinsic faithfulness by adding physics, commonsense, and human-fidelity dimensions. Its physics checks remain coarse, however, consisting mainly of VLM question answering on state changes (mechanics, thermotics, material), with feature-matching geometry for multi-view consistency. More recent world-model benchmarks broaden the evaluation scope beyond visual quality. HappyWorld-Bench [ 1 ] evaluates video, spatial, and embodied world models, with an emphasis on consistency and responsiveness during exploration, interaction, and modification.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型评测套件将视频质量分解为感知与语义两类指标，这些指标通过预训练感知模型或作为评判者的多模态大语言模型计算得出。 VBench 和 VBench++ [ 16 , 17 ] 涵盖时间一致性、运动平滑度以及文本-视频对齐，而 EvalCrafter [ 26 ] 和 T2V-CompBench [ 44 ] 则汇总了人类偏好与组合对齐指标。 VBench-2.0 [ 56 ] 通过增加物理、常识和人类保真度维度，向内在真实性迈进。 然而，其物理检查仍然较为粗略，主要依靠视觉语言模型针对状态变化（力学、热学、材料）进行问答，并对多视角一致性采用特征匹配几何方法。 更近期的世界模型基准将评测范围拓展至视觉质量之外。 HappyWorld-Bench [ 1 ] 评测视频、空间与具身世界模型，重点考察在探索、交互与修改过程中的一致性和响应性。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work targets physical plausibility directly. VideoPhy-2 [ 2 ] and PhyWorldBench [ 14 ] rely on human or MLLM semantic judgments over action-centric activities and diverse prompt categories; PhyGenBench [ 28 ] scores 27 physical principles with a hierarchical VLM evaluator; WorldModelBench [ 22 ] rates five physical laws as binary outcomes; Physics-IQ [ 32 ] measures motion-mask overlap on real-scene continuation, with metrics the authors acknowledge remain proxies rather than direct physical quantities. WorldScore [ 10 ] is the most quantitative, reconstructing camera trajectories with DROID-SLAM [ 47 ] and computing reprojection error, dense depth, and optical-flow AEPE. However, these physical-plausibility benchmarks are still limited to semantic judgments and coarse-grained categories, and the few quantitative ones measure only camera-centric geometry. To address these challenges, we evaluate generated videos through numerical physical quantities extracted by specialized models and checked against physical laws.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条平行的研究路线直接针对物理合理性。 VideoPhy-2 [ 2 ] 和 PhyWorldBench [ 14 ] 依赖于对以动作为中心的活动和多样化提示类别的人类或 MLLM 语义判断；PhyGenBench [ 28 ] 使用层级式 VLM 评估器对 27 条物理原理进行评分；WorldModelBench [ 22 ] 将五条物理定律评定为二元结果；Physics-IQ [ 32 ] 在真实场景续写上测量运动掩码重叠度，其作者也承认这些指标仍是替代性度量而非直接的物理量。 WorldScore [ 10 ] 是其中最定量化的，它使用 DROID-SLAM [ 47 ] 重建相机轨迹，并计算重投影误差、稠密深度和光流 AEPE。 然而，这些物理合理性基准仍局限于语义判断和粗粒度类别，而少数定量化的基准也只测量以相机为中心的几何量。 为应对这些挑战，我们通过专门模型提取数值物理量并依据物理定律加以检验，来评估生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: PVBench evaluates generated videos along 46 dimensions. These 46 dimensions are organized into 7 domains and span three assessment layers: semantic, perceptual, and physical. The physical layer encompasses 4 domains with 25 dimensions in total, which are further divided into three families: object-intrinsic physical properties, relations between objects and space, and object dynamics across space and time, covering most common physical quantities. The overall framework is shown in Fig. 1 ; the complete correspondence is given in Appendix A , Table A1 .
paragraphs.zh: PVBench 从 46 个维度评估生成的视频。 这 46 个维度被组织为 7 个领域，并覆盖三个评估层面：语义、感知和物理。 物理层面包含 4 个领域、共 25 个维度，这些维度进一步划分为三族：物体固有物理属性、物体与空间之间的关系，以及物体在空间和时间中的动态，涵盖了大多数常见物理量。 整体框架如图 1 所示；完整的对应关系见附录 A 中的表 A1。

paragraphs.en: PVBench turns “physical plausibility” from a qualitative question into a numerically testable one. Except for dimensions that are difficult to quantify, each physical dimension is paired with a computable physical quantity and a physical-law consistency criterion. Semantic and perceptual dimensions follow or adapt existing paradigms, allowing the physical score to be interpreted jointly with semantic fidelity and visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: PVBench 将“物理合理性”从一个定性问题转变为一个可量化检验的问题。 除难以量化的维度外，每个物理维度都配有一个可计算的物理量和一个物理定律一致性判据。 语义维度和感知维度遵循或改编现有范式，使物理得分能够与语义保真度和视觉质量共同解读。

paragraphs.en: Compared with prior works, PVBench covers physical dimensions more comprehensively, evaluates primarily through quantitative computation of physical quantities, and uses MLLM to supplement dimensions that are hard to quantify.
paragraphs.zh: 与已有工作相比，PVBench 更全面地覆盖了物理维度，主要通过物理量的定量计算进行评估，并使用多模态大语言模型补充难以量化的维度。

paragraphs.en: Diverse Dedicated Scene Construction. Prompts fall into three categories: 1) for each of the 46 evaluation dimensions, 5 tailored prompts are designed; 2) related dimensions are paired in all 23 dimension pairs, each pair corresponding to 10 hybrid prompts; 3) embodied agents are injected, together with controlled occlusion, camera motion, and other visual confounders, as a high-difficulty supplement. The three categories total 600 prompt groups, each containing a one-to-one T2V and I2V variant, of which 30% involve embodied-agent scenarios (Fig. 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 多样化的专用场景构建。 提示词分为三类：1）针对46个评估维度中的每一个，设计了5个定制化提示词；2）将相关维度两两配对，构成全部23个维度对，每个维度对对应10个混合提示词；3）注入具身智能体，并配合受控遮挡、相机运动及其他视觉干扰因素，作为高难度补充。 三类提示词共600个提示词组，每组包含一个一一对应的文生视频（T2V）和图生视频（I2V）变体，其中30%涉及具身智能体场景（图3）。

paragraphs.en: LLM-Assisted Prompt Construction. Each prompt group is built in three steps: 1) given the target dimensions and scene specification, draft the prompt with GPT-5.6 Sol [ 34 ] , explicitly instantiating objects, multi-stage actions, and observability constraints; 2) each draft is manually screened for physical plausibility, visual feasibility, and unambiguous observability, modified or discarded if necessary; 3) the reference image of the I2V variant is synthesized by the GPT-image-2 model [ 35 ] from the first-frame description of the prompt, so that the T2V and I2V variants share the same initial scene (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: LLM辅助的提示词构建。 每个提示词组通过三个步骤构建：1）给定目标维度和场景规范，使用GPT-5.6 Sol [ 34 ] 起草提示词，显式实例化对象、多阶段动作和可观测性约束；2）对每个草稿进行人工筛选，检查物理合理性、视觉可行性和无歧义的可观测性，必要时进行修改或舍弃；3）I2V变体的参考图像由GPT-image-2模型 [ 35 ] 根据提示词的首帧描述合成，使T2V和I2V变体共享相同的初始场景（图2）。

sents.en: PVBench metrics have three layers: semantic, perceptual, and physical.
sents.zh: PVBench 的指标分为三个层次：语义、感知和物理。

sents.en: They are subdivided by evaluation target into 7 domains for a total of 46 dimensions.

paragraphs.en: Semantic layer examines the consistency between the generated video and the conditioning information and commonsense logic, covering 2 domains and 14 dimensions. Condition and semantic fidelity (CSF) measures whether the video is faithful to the input condition, covering instruction following, attribute correctness, spatial relations, style, negation, scene, camera motion, and reference-condition following. Behavioral, causal, and commonsense consistency (BC) measures whether actions and timing unfold as instructed, and whether behavior conforms to physical, biological, and social commonsense.
paragraphs.zh: 语义层检验生成视频与条件信息及常识逻辑之间的一致性，涵盖2个领域和14个维度。 条件与语义保真度（CSF）衡量视频是否忠实于输入条件，涵盖指令遵循、属性正确性、空间关系、风格、否定、场景、镜头运动以及参考条件遵循。 行为、因果与常识一致性（BC）衡量动作和时间进程是否按指令展开，以及行为是否符合物理、生物和社会常识。

sents.zh: 语义层检验生成视频与条件信息及常识逻辑之间的一致性，涵盖2个领域和14个维度。

sents.en: Condition and semantic fidelity (CSF) measures whether the video is faithful to the input condition, covering instruction following, attribute correctness, spatial relations, style, negation, scene, camera motion, and reference-condition following.
sents.zh: 条件与语义保真度（CSF）衡量视频是否忠实于输入条件，涵盖指令遵循、属性正确性、空间关系、风格、否定、场景、镜头运动以及参考条件遵循。

sents.en: Behavioral, causal, and commonsense consistency (BC) measures whether actions and timing unfold as instructed, and whether behavior conforms to physical, biological, and social commonsense.
sents.zh: 行为、因果与常识一致性（BC）衡量动作和时间进程是否按指令展开，以及行为是否符合物理、生物和社会常识。

paragraphs.en: The perceptual layer , termed Perceptual and Temporal Quality (PTQ), evaluates the visual quality of video frames and temporal dynamics across 7 dimensions. It covers subject consistency, aesthetic quality, motion smoothness, temporal flickering, dynamic degree, background and imaging quality. The semantic and perceptual layers follow or adapt existing evaluation paradigms, so that the physical-layer score can be interpreted jointly with semantic fidelity and image quality.
paragraphs.zh: 感知层称为感知与时序质量（PTQ），从7个维度评估视频帧的视觉质量与时序动态。 它涵盖主体一致性、美学质量、运动平滑性、时序闪烁、动态程度、背景与成像质量。 语义层与感知层遵循或改编现有的评估范式，以便物理层评分能够与语义保真度和图像质量结合起来解读。

sents.en: The perceptual layer , termed Perceptual and Temporal Quality (PTQ), evaluates the visual quality of video frames and temporal dynamics across 7 dimensions.
sents.zh: 感知层称为感知与时序质量（PTQ），从7个维度评估视频帧的视觉质量与时序动态。

sents.en: It covers subject consistency, aesthetic quality, motion smoothness, temporal flickering, dynamic degree, background and imaging quality.
sents.zh: 它涵盖主体一致性、美学质量、运动平滑性、时序闪烁、动态程度、背景与成像质量。

sents.en: The semantic and perceptual layers follow or adapt existing evaluation paradigms, so that the physical-layer score can be interpreted jointly with semantic fidelity and image quality.
sents.zh: 语义层与感知层遵循或改编现有的评估范式，以便物理层评分能够与语义保真度和图像质量结合起来解读。

paragraphs.en: Physical layer is the core of PVBench, covering 4 domains and 25 dimensions, divided by the type of physical quantity measured. Geometric and spatial consistency (GS) evaluates the spatial self-consistency of geometric quantities such as depth, normals, shape, scale, pose, spatial relations, and cross-frame geometry. Material properties and field states (MFS) evaluates material attributes and field quantities such as deformation, material, thermal radiation, light/shadow, magnetic/electric, and phase change. Kinematics and spatiotemporal persistence (KP) evaluates kinematic quantities such as displacement, velocity, and angular velocity, as well as spatiotemporal persistence properties such as motion continuity and object permanence. Mechanical plausibility and conservation laws (MC) evaluates mechanical and conserved quantities such as static stability, dynamic effects of forces, momentum conservation, and energy conservation.
paragraphs.zh: 物理层是 PVBench 的核心，涵盖 4 个领域和 25 个维度，按所测物理量的类型划分。 几何与空间一致性（GS）评估深度、法线、形状、尺度、位姿、空间关系和跨帧几何等几何量的空间自洽性。 材料属性与场状态（MFS）评估形变、材料、热辐射、光/影、磁/电和相变等材料属性与场量。 运动学与时空持续性（KP）评估位移、速度和角速度等运动学量，以及运动连续性和物体恒存性等时空持续性属性。 力学合理性与守恒定律（MC）评估静力稳定性、力的动态效应、动量守恒和能量守恒等力学量与守恒量。

sents.en: Physical layer is the core of PVBench, covering 4 domains and 25 dimensions, divided by the type of physical quantity measured.
sents.zh: 物理层是 PVBench 的核心，涵盖 4 个领域和 25 个维度，按所测物理量的类型划分。

sents.en: Geometric and spatial consistency (GS) evaluates the spatial self-consistency of geometric quantities such as depth, normals, shape, scale, pose, spatial relations, and cross-frame geometry.
sents.zh: 几何与空间一致性（GS）评估深度、法线、形状、尺度、位姿、空间关系和跨帧几何等几何量的空间自洽性。

sents.en: Material properties and field states (MFS) evaluates material attributes and field quantities such as deformation, material, thermal radiation, light/shadow, magnetic/electric, and phase change.
sents.zh: 材料属性与场状态（MFS）评估形变、材料、热辐射、光/影、磁/电和相变等材料属性与场量。

sents.en: Kinematics and spatiotemporal persistence (KP) evaluates kinematic quantities such as displacement, velocity, and angular velocity, as well as spatiotemporal persistence properties such as motion continuity and object permanence.
sents.zh: 运动学与时空持续性（KP）评估位移、速度和角速度等运动学量，以及运动连续性和物体恒存性等时空持续性属性。

sents.en: Mechanical plausibility and conservation laws (MC) evaluates mechanical and conserved quantities such as static stability, dynamic effects of forces, momentum conservation, and energy conservation.
sents.zh: 力学合理性与守恒定律（MC）评估静力稳定性、力的动态效应、动量守恒和能量守恒等力学量与守恒量。

paragraphs.en: Where quantification is possible, each physical dimension is paired with a specialized vision foundation model that outputs numerical physical quantities rather than semantic judgments; this is the fundamental difference between PVBench and previous physical benchmarks. But not all physical quantities can be directly quantified, in which case MLLM-assisted judgment is introduced. By evaluation method, the physical evaluation of PVBench is thus divided into three paradigms: i) specialized-model quantitative evaluation ; ii) specialized-model measurement with MLLM judgment ; iii) pure MLLM semantic scoring . Among the 25 physical dimensions, 17 are evaluated purely numerically, 4 rely on pure MLLM scoring, and 4 use hybrid measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 在可以量化的地方，每个物理维度都配有一个专门的视觉基础模型，输出数值型物理量而非语义判断；这是 PVBench 与以往物理基准测试的根本区别。 但并非所有物理量都能被直接量化，此时引入 MLLM 辅助判断。 按评估方法划分，PVBench 的物理评估因此分为三种范式：i) 专门模型定量评估；ii) 专门模型测量结合 MLLM 判断；iii) 纯 MLLM 语义评分。 在 25 个物理维度中，17 个采用纯数值评估，4 个依赖纯 MLLM 评分，4 个采用混合测量。

paragraphs.en: Physical quantity values are mapped to a 1 to 5 score through thresholds, which are manually set according to the reasonable range of the physical quantity; their fit to human judgment is verified by the human validation in Section 3.4 . Each dimension first takes the mean over its samples, then the domain and overall scores are obtained by equal-weight averaging across dimensions, avoiding dimensions with more samples from dominating the total. In the final report, scores are uniformly linearly mapped to a percentile scale.The specific physical quantities, formulas, specialized models used, and threshold-mapping details for each physical dimension are given in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 物理量数值通过阈值映射为 1 到 5 的分数，阈值根据物理量的合理范围手动设定，其与人类判断的契合度由第 3.4 节的人工验证予以确认。 每个维度先对其样本取均值，然后通过对各维度等权平均得到领域分数和总分，避免样本更多的维度主导总分。 在最终报告中，分数被统一线性映射为百分位量表。各物理维度所使用的具体物理量、公式、专用模型以及阈值映射细节见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: To verify the consistency between evaluator scores and human judgments, we selected three T2V models and 5 evaluation prompts per physical dimension for manual annotation and scoring. For each evaluation dimension, we wrote detailed guidelines and examples, and annotators were trained first to fully understand the metric definition. Each sample was independently scored by 10 annotators and averaged. The results of this experiment are presented in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为验证评估器打分与人类判断之间的一致性，我们选取了三个 T2V 模型以及每个物理维度 5 条评估提示词，进行人工标注与打分。 针对每个评估维度，我们编写了详细的准则与示例，并对标注人员进行培训，使其充分理解指标定义。 每个样本由 10 名标注人员独立打分并取平均值。 该实验的结果在第 4.3 节中给出。

sents.en: The results of this experiment are presented in Section 4.3 .
sents.zh: 该实验的结果在第 4.3 节中给出。

paragraphs.en: PVBench differs from prior benchmarks primarily in the unit of evaluation: instead of asking whether a video looks physically plausible, it estimates observable physical states and evaluates their consistency with prompt-conditioned physical constraints and laws. This shift from holistic semantic judgment to computable physical-state evaluation is the core novelty of PVBench. In contrast to prior video benchmarks, which either emphasize semantic and perceptual quality or assess physical plausibility mainly through human or MLLM judgments, binary outcomes, proxy metrics, or camera-centric geometry, PVBench makes physical plausibility measurable at the level of object states and physical laws.
paragraphs.zh: PVBench 与以往基准的主要区别在于评估单位：它不是判断一段视频在物理上是否看起来合理，而是估计可观测的物理状态，并评估这些状态与以提示词为条件的物理约束和物理定律之间的一致性。 从整体性语义判断到可计算的物理状态评估这一转变，是 PVBench 的核心创新。 以往的视频基准要么强调语义与感知质量，要么主要通过人类或多模态大模型的判断、二元结果、代理指标或以相机为中心的几何来评估物理合理性；与之不同，PVBench 在物体状态和物理定律的层面上使物理合理性变得可度量。

paragraphs.en: Semantic and Perceptual Layer Results. Overall, the semantic and perceptual layers can distinguish different models in condition following, behavior understanding, and visual quality, but the three do not show a completely consistent ranking. For example, SANA-Video 2.0 in the T2V configuration scores 58.2 in perception and temporal quality (PTQ), but only 39.0 in behavioral and causal commonsense (BC). This illustrates that a model can produce reasonably polished frames and temporal dynamics while remaining weak in action causality and commonsense reasoning; perceptual quality and behavioral plausibility are not equivalent. The semantic and perceptual layer results provide a reference for the physical-layer analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 语义与感知层结果。 总体而言，语义层和感知层能够在条件遵循、行为理解和视觉质量方面区分不同模型，但三者并未表现出完全一致的排序。 例如，T2V 配置下的 SANA-Video 2.0 在感知与时间质量（PTQ）上得分为 58.2，但在行为与因果常识（BC）上仅为 39.0。 这说明一个模型可以生成相当精致的画面和时间动态，同时在动作因果性和常识推理方面仍然较弱；感知质量与行为合理性并不等价。 语义与感知层的结果为物理层分析提供了参考。

paragraphs.en: Physical Layer Results. Overall, the scores of geometric space and kinematic persistence are higher than those of material field states and mechanical conservation, indicating that generated videos maintain visible geometric structure and general motion trajectories relatively stably, while material field states and mechanical/conservation relations are more difficult. The low-score distribution of mechanical conservation especially shows that visual continuity or action completion alone is insufficient to guarantee that the result conforms to mechanical laws.
paragraphs.zh: 物理层结果。 总体来看，几何空间与运动持续性的得分高于物质场状态与机械守恒，表明生成的视频能够相对稳定地保持可见的几何结构和总体运动轨迹，而物质场状态与机械/守恒关系则更为困难。 机械守恒的低分分布尤其表明，仅有视觉连续性或动作完成并不足以保证结果符合力学规律。

paragraphs.en: Insight 1. Visual quality is not equivalent to physical plausibility. Although mainstream models can score highly on semantic and perceptual metrics, their physical-layer scores are generally lower. Some models that lead in visual quality and semantic fidelity rank lower physically, showing that visual impression or semantic alignment alone does not establish physical plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: 洞察 1。 视觉质量并不等同于物理合理性。 尽管主流模型在语义和感知指标上可以获得高分，但它们在物理层面的得分通常较低。 一些在视觉质量和语义保真度上领先的模型在物理层面排名较低，这表明仅凭视觉印象或语义对齐并不能确立物理合理性。

sents.zh: 洞察 1。

paragraphs.en: Insight 2. Models remain weak at mechanics and conservation laws. Unlike geometry and general motion, mechanical conservation jointly involves object trajectories, interactions, and energy or momentum relations, demanding stronger spatiotemporal modeling. Scores remain low across models, revealing deficiencies in collisions, forces, and energy changes.
paragraphs.zh: 洞察 2。 模型在力学与守恒定律方面仍然较弱。 与几何和一般运动不同，力学守恒同时涉及物体轨迹、相互作用以及能量或动量关系，对时空建模能力提出了更高要求。 各模型的得分仍然很低，暴露出其在碰撞、力和能量变化方面的不足。

paragraphs.en: T2V vs. I2V: the Role of First-Frame Prior. To analyze the role of the first-frame prior, we first compare the T2V and I2V configurations of MiniMax H3. paragraphs.en: Physical-Layer Domain Ablation. To examine how each physical-layer domain contributes to the overall physical score, we perform a leave-one-out ablation on the four domains (GS, MFS, KP, MC) using the results in Table 2 . For each model, we recompute the physical-layer average after removing one domain. Averaged over the six T2V models, the full physical-layer score is 38.5. Removing MC raises the average to 43.4, and removing MFS raises it to 41.9, whereas removing GS or KP decreases it to 35.0 and 33.6, respectively. This shows that MC and MFS are the main factors pulling down the overall physical score, while GS and KP contribute relatively higher scores. The consistently low MC scores further indicate that current models are generally weak in mechanics and conservation laws. These results support reporting the four physical domains separately, as they reveal distinct weaknesses across different aspects of physical plausibility.

paragraphs.en: Video generation looks increasingly realistic, yet its physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Existing evaluations rely on semantic binary judgments or camera-centric geometry, and cannot reduce physical plausibility to computable, testable quantities. We propose PVBench, a physical-quantity-driven benchmark that extracts numerical measurements with specialized vision models, checks them against physical laws, uses same-scene T2V/I2V paired prompts, and resorts to MLLM scoring only for hard-to-quantify dimensions. Our key finding is that numerical physical-quantity scores are more discriminative than MLLM semantic scores and highly consistent with human judgments, enabling more reliable and quantifiable evaluation. We hope PVBench becomes a quantifiable yardstick for physically plausible video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成看起来日益逼真，但其物理合理性仍然缺乏充分的度量。 现有的评估依赖于语义层面的二元判断或以相机为中心的几何信息，无法将物理合理性转化为可计算、可测试的量。 我们提出 PVBench，一个由物理量驱动的基准，它利用专门的视觉模型提取数值测量值，依据物理定律进行检验，使用同场景的 T2V/I2V 成对提示词，并仅对难以量化的维度才借助 MLLM 打分。 我们的关键发现是，数值化的物理量评分比 MLLM 语义评分更具区分度，且与人类判断高度一致，从而实现更可靠、可量化的评估。 我们希望 PVBench 能成为衡量物理合理视频生成的一把可量化的标尺。

sents.en: Existing evaluations rely on semantic binary judgments or camera-centric geometry, and cannot reduce physical plausibility to computable, testable quantities.
sents.zh: 现有的评估依赖于语义层面的二元判断或以相机为中心的几何信息，无法将物理合理性转化为可计算、可测试的量。

sents.en: We propose PVBench, a physical-quantity-driven benchmark that extracts numerical measurements with specialized vision models, checks them against physical laws, uses same-scene T2V/I2V paired prompts, and resorts to MLLM scoring only for hard-to-quantify dimensions.
sents.zh: 我们提出 PVBench，一个由物理量驱动的基准，它利用专门的视觉模型提取数值测量值，依据物理定律进行检验，使用同场景的 T2V/I2V 成对提示词，并仅对难以量化的维度才借助 MLLM 打分。

sents.en: Our key finding is that numerical physical-quantity scores are more discriminative than MLLM semantic scores and highly consistent with human judgments, enabling more reliable and quantifiable evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们的关键发现是，数值化的物理量评分比 MLLM 语义评分更具区分度，且与人类判断高度一致，从而实现更可靠、可量化的评估。

sents.en: We hope PVBench becomes a quantifiable yardstick for physically plausible video generation.
sents.zh: 我们希望 PVBench 能成为衡量物理合理视频生成的一把可量化的标尺。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. The evaluation depends on specialized vision models and skips only a small number of samples for unobservable cases; material and phase-change dimensions still use MLLM scoring. We only ablate the VLM backend, and a full ablation of the specialized evaluators is left for future work. Moreover, the current evaluation largely relies on checking consistency with physical laws and, except for a few dimensions, lacks ground-truth references. More robust tracking and finer physical quantities will improve coverage. In future work, we plan to build ground-truth references for conditional image-to-video (CI2V) models using physics engines and other simulation tools to enable more direct evaluation. We will also expand the benchmark as compute and open-source models grow.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 该评估依赖于专门的视觉模型，仅跳过少量不可观测情形的样本；材质与相变维度仍使用 MLLM 打分。 我们仅对 VLM 后端进行了消融实验，对专门评估器的完整消融留待未来工作。 此外，当前评估主要依赖与物理定律的一致性检验，除少数维度外缺乏真实基准参考。 更稳健的追踪和更精细的物理量将提高覆盖率。 在未来工作中，我们计划使用物理引擎和其他仿真工具为条件图像到视频（CI2V）模型构建真实基准参考，以实现更直接的评估。 随着算力和开源模型的增长，我们还将扩展该基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Below, the physical quantity, formula, and criterion extracted for each of the 25 physical dimensions are explained one by one by D4 to D7; the 1 to 5 threshold segments for each physical quantity are in Section D.3 Table A15 .
paragraphs.zh: 下文将逐一解释由 D4 至 D7 提取的 25 个物理维度所对应的物理量、公式和判据；每个物理量的 1 至 5 阈值区间见 D.3 节表 A15。

paragraphs.en: We estimate the per-frame depth map using Depth Anything 3. Using the object occlusion regions segmented by SAM 3, we verify the depth-order accuracy, i.e., the depth of the occluded object should be greater than the depth of the occluder; the higher the depth-order accuracy, the higher the score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Depth Anything 3 估计逐帧深度图。 利用 SAM 3 分割出的物体遮挡区域，我们验证深度顺序的准确性，即被遮挡物体的深度应大于遮挡物的深度；深度顺序准确率越高，得分越高。

sents.en: We estimate the per-frame depth map using Depth Anything 3.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Depth Anything 3 估计逐帧深度图。

sents.en: Using the object occlusion regions segmented by SAM 3, we verify the depth-order accuracy, i.e., the depth of the occluded object should be greater than the depth of the occluder; the higher the depth-order accuracy, the higher the score.
sents.zh: 利用 SAM 3 分割出的物体遮挡区域，我们验证深度顺序的准确性，即被遮挡物体的深度应大于遮挡物的深度；深度顺序准确率越高，得分越高。

paragraphs.en: Estimated per-frame surface normal map by StableNormal, cross-validated with the geometric consistency provided by VGGT- Ω \Omega to check the consistency of normals with the depth gradient; the higher the consistency, the higher the score.
paragraphs.zh: 由 StableNormal 估计的逐帧表面法线图，并与 VGGT- Ω \Omega 提供的几何一致性进行交叉验证，以检查法线与深度梯度的一致性；一致性越高，得分越高。

paragraphs.en: Per-frame 3D point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega ; after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] of cross-frame point clouds, the normalized Chamfer distance measures shape cross-frame self-consistency; non-standard geometry is semantically judged by Qwen3.8-27B. Higher self-consistency means more consistent shape.
paragraphs.zh: 由 VGGT-Ω 重构的逐帧三维点云；在对跨帧点云进行 Kabsch 对齐 [18] 后，用归一化 Chamfer 距离度量形状的跨帧自一致性；非标准几何由 Qwen3.8-27B 进行语义判断。 自一致性越高，表示形状越一致。

sents.en: Per-frame 3D point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega ; after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] of cross-frame point clouds, the normalized Chamfer distance measures shape cross-frame self-consistency; non-standard geometry is semantically judged by Qwen3.8-27B.
sents.zh: 由 VGGT-Ω 重构的逐帧三维点云；在对跨帧点云进行 Kabsch 对齐 [18] 后，用归一化 Chamfer 距离度量形状的跨帧自一致性；非标准几何由 Qwen3.8-27B 进行语义判断。

sents.en: Higher self-consistency means more consistent shape.
sents.zh: 自一致性越高，表示形状越一致。

paragraphs.en: Metric scale prior provided by Depth Anything 3, combined with the object size segmented by SAM 3, Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the object size falls in a reasonable range; the more reasonable, the higher the score.
paragraphs.zh: Depth Anything 3 提供的度量尺度先验，结合 SAM 3 分割出的物体尺寸，由 Qwen3.8-27B 判断物体尺寸是否处于合理范围内；越合理，得分越高。

paragraphs.en: For multiple views of the same scene (multiple frames produced by camera motion), VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstructs each separately, and the reprojection error and geometric self-consistency residual are computed to measure whether the 3D structure is consistent across views. Smaller residual is better.
paragraphs.zh: 对于同一场景的多个视角（由相机运动产生的多帧），VGGT-Ω \Omega 对每个视角分别进行重建，并计算重投影误差和几何自洽残差，以衡量 3D 结构在各视角之间是否一致。 残差越小越好。

sents.en: For multiple views of the same scene (multiple frames produced by camera motion), VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstructs each separately, and the reprojection error and geometric self-consistency residual are computed to measure whether the 3D structure is consistent across views.
sents.zh: 对于同一场景的多个视角（由相机运动产生的多帧），VGGT-Ω \Omega 对每个视角分别进行重建，并计算重投影误差和几何自洽残差，以衡量 3D 结构在各视角之间是否一致。

sents.en: Smaller residual is better.
sents.zh: 残差越小越好。

paragraphs.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega estimates the cross-frame bounding-box size of the object, and the coefficient of variation CV = σ / μ \mathrm{CV}=\sigma/\mu of the size sequence is computed, with SAM 3 segmentation ensuring the same object corresponds across frames. Smaller CV means more stable relative scale.
paragraphs.zh: VGGT- Ω \Omega 估计目标的跨帧边界框尺寸，并计算尺寸序列的变异系数 CV = σ / μ \mathrm{CV}=\sigma/\mu，其中 SAM 3 分割确保跨帧对应的是同一目标。 CV 越小表示相对尺度越稳定。

sents.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega estimates the cross-frame bounding-box size of the object, and the coefficient of variation CV = σ / μ \mathrm{CV}=\sigma/\mu of the size sequence is computed, with SAM 3 segmentation ensuring the same object corresponds across frames.
sents.zh: VGGT- Ω \Omega 估计目标的跨帧边界框尺寸，并计算尺寸序列的变异系数 CV = σ / μ \mathrm{CV}=\sigma/\mu，其中 SAM 3 分割确保跨帧对应的是同一目标。

sents.en: Smaller CV means more stable relative scale.
sents.zh: CV 越小表示相对尺度越稳定。

paragraphs.en: Any6D estimates the six-degree-of-freedom pose of the object; combined with VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry, Qwen3.8-27B compares whether the final pose change matches the known pose change specified by the prompt; the higher the match, the higher the score.
paragraphs.zh: Any6D 估计物体的六自由度位姿；结合 VGGT- \Omega 几何，Qwen3.8-27B 比较最终位姿变化是否与提示词中指定的已知位姿变化相匹配；匹配度越高，得分越高。

paragraphs.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega back-projects to obtain the 3D coordinates of object centroids, computes the relative position and distance between objects, and compares consistency with the spatial relation described by the prompt (above/below/left/right/front/back/containment, etc.). Consistent gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: VGGT- \Omega 反投影以获取物体质心的三维坐标，计算物体之间的相对位置和距离，并将其与提示词所描述的空间关系（上下左右前后、包含等）进行一致性比较。 一致则给出高分。

sents.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega back-projects to obtain the 3D coordinates of object centroids, computes the relative position and distance between objects, and compares consistency with the spatial relation described by the prompt (above/below/left/right/front/back/containment, etc.).
sents.zh: VGGT- \Omega 反投影以获取物体质心的三维坐标，计算物体之间的相对位置和距离，并将其与提示词所描述的空间关系（上下左右前后、包含等）进行一致性比较。

sents.en: Consistent gives a high score.
sents.zh: 一致则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: On the one hand, VGGT- Ω \Omega independently reconstructs point clouds for adjacent frames and computes the cross-frame Chamfer drift (relaxed for the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline); on the other hand, FlowSeek computes the coefficient of variation CV of the average endpoint error AEPE of per-frame optical flow. Both smaller indicate more stable cross-frame geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，VGGT-Ω \Ω 独立重建相邻帧的点云并计算跨帧的倒角漂移（针对 VGGT-Ω \Ω 重建噪声基线进行了放宽）；另一方面，FlowSeek 计算每帧光流平均端点误差 AEPE 的变异系数 CV。 两项数值越小，表示跨帧几何越稳定。

sents.en: On the one hand, VGGT- Ω \Omega independently reconstructs point clouds for adjacent frames and computes the cross-frame Chamfer drift (relaxed for the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline); on the other hand, FlowSeek computes the coefficient of variation CV of the average endpoint error AEPE of per-frame optical flow.
sents.zh: 一方面，VGGT-Ω \Ω 独立重建相邻帧的点云并计算跨帧的倒角漂移（针对 VGGT-Ω \Ω 重建噪声基线进行了放宽）；另一方面，FlowSeek 计算每帧光流平均端点误差 AEPE 的变异系数 CV。

sents.en: Both smaller indicate more stable cross-frame geometry.
sents.zh: 两项数值越小，表示跨帧几何越稳定。

paragraphs.en: Per-frame point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega , combined with the object trajectory of SpatialTracker V2, after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] compute the normalized Chamfer distance or rigid-body distance change rate to measure deformation; the threshold is higher than the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline (about 0.08 to 0.15) to avoid mistaking reconstruction noise for deformation. A smaller change rate means closer to rigid body.
paragraphs.zh: 由 VGGT- Ω \Omega 重建的逐帧点云，结合 SpatialTracker V2 的物体轨迹，在经过 Kabsch 对齐 [ 18 ] 后，计算归一化 Chamfer 距离或刚体距离变化率来度量形变；该阈值高于 VGGT- Ω \Omega 的重建噪声基线（约 0.08 到 0.15），以避免将重建噪声误判为形变。 变化率越小意味着越接近刚体。

sents.en: Per-frame point clouds reconstructed by VGGT- Ω \Omega , combined with the object trajectory of SpatialTracker V2, after Kabsch alignment [ 18 ] compute the normalized Chamfer distance or rigid-body distance change rate to measure deformation; the threshold is higher than the VGGT- Ω \Omega reconstruction noise baseline (about 0.08 to 0.15) to avoid mistaking reconstruction noise for deformation.
sents.zh: 由 VGGT- Ω \Omega 重建的逐帧点云，结合 SpatialTracker V2 的物体轨迹，在经过 Kabsch 对齐 [ 18 ] 后，计算归一化 Chamfer 距离或刚体距离变化率来度量形变；该阈值高于 VGGT- Ω \Omega 的重建噪声基线（约 0.08 到 0.15），以避免将重建噪声误判为形变。

sents.en: A smaller change rate means closer to rigid body.
sents.zh: 变化率越小意味着越接近刚体。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional material check on the video (material category, hardness/softness, translucency, reflectivity, surface texture), judging item by item whether it conforms to physical commonsense. All dimensions reasonable gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 对视频进行五维材质检查（材质类别、软硬程度、透光性、反光性、表面纹理），逐项判断其是否符合物理常识。 所有维度均合理则给出高分。

sents.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional material check on the video (material category, hardness/softness, translucency, reflectivity, surface texture), judging item by item whether it conforms to physical commonsense.
sents.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 对视频进行五维材质检查（材质类别、软硬程度、透光性、反光性、表面纹理），逐项判断其是否符合物理常识。

sents.en: All dimensions reasonable gives a high score.
sents.zh: 所有维度均合理则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional radiation check (heat source identification, heat conduction direction, heat-induced luminescence/color change, thermal convection/updraft, no abnormal radiation from low-temperature objects), judging item by item whether it conforms to thermodynamic laws. Conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 执行五维辐射检查（热源识别、热传导方向、热致发光/颜色变化、热对流/上升气流、低温物体无异常辐射），逐项判断其是否符合热力学定律。 符合则给予高分。

sents.en: Qwen3.8-27B performs a five-dimensional radiation check (heat source identification, heat conduction direction, heat-induced luminescence/color change, thermal convection/updraft, no abnormal radiation from low-temperature objects), judging item by item whether it conforms to thermodynamic laws.
sents.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 执行五维辐射检查（热源识别、热传导方向、热致发光/颜色变化、热对流/上升气流、低温物体无异常辐射），逐项判断其是否符合热力学定律。

sents.en: Conforming gives a high score.
sents.zh: 符合则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: ReasonX estimates the back-inferred light source direction of each object, combined with the normal of StableNormal, computes the variance of the back-inferred light source directions of each object in the same scene and the photometric/shadow-position residual (degrees); the smaller the variance and residual, the more self-consistent the light/shadow is spatially.
paragraphs.zh: ReasonX 估计每个物体反推的光源方向，并结合 StableNormal 的法线，计算同一场景中各物体反推光源方向的方差以及光度/阴影位置残差（单位：度）；方差和残差越小，说明光影在空间上越自洽。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of electromagnetic/electrostatic phenomena in the video (like poles repel and unlike poles attract, the effect of the magnetic field on ferromagnetic objects, electrostatic adsorption of light small objects, the arc of the Van de Graaff generator along field lines, tip discharge, etc.). Correct phenomena give a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断视频中电磁/静电现象的正确性（同名磁极相斥、异名磁极相吸，磁场对铁磁性物体的作用，静电吸附轻小物体，范德格拉夫起电机沿电场线的电弧，尖端放电等）。 现象正确则给高分。

sents.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of electromagnetic/electrostatic phenomena in the video (like poles repel and unlike poles attract, the effect of the magnetic field on ferromagnetic objects, electrostatic adsorption of light small objects, the arc of the Van de Graaff generator along field lines, tip discharge, etc.).
sents.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断视频中电磁/静电现象的正确性（同名磁极相斥、异名磁极相吸，磁场对铁磁性物体的作用，静电吸附轻小物体，范德格拉夫起电机沿电场线的电弧，尖端放电等）。

sents.en: Correct phenomena give a high score.
sents.zh: 现象正确则给高分。

paragraphs.en: ReasonX estimates the main light direction L ⁡ ( t ) L(t) , and after camera-motion compensation to the world coordinate system, checks its temporal stability (degrees); the more stable the direction, the more consistent the light/shadow is temporally.
paragraphs.zh: ReasonX 估计主光方向 L ⁡ ( t ) L(t)，并在进行相机运动补偿至世界坐标系后，检查其时间稳定性（度）；方向越稳定，光影在时间上的一致性越高。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of the phase transition process (conditions and direction of solid, liquid, and gas transition, temperature change due to latent heat, volume/morphology changes accompanying phase transition, etc.). A reasonable process gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 评判相变过程的正确性（固、液、气三态转变的条件与方向、潜热引起的温度变化、伴随相变发生的体积/形态变化等）。 过程合理则给予高分。

sents.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the correctness of the phase transition process (conditions and direction of solid, liquid, and gas transition, temperature change due to latent heat, volume/morphology changes accompanying phase transition, etc.).
sents.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 评判相变过程的正确性（固、液、气三态转变的条件与方向、潜热引起的温度变化、伴随相变发生的体积/形态变化等）。

sents.en: A reasonable process gives a high score.
sents.zh: 过程合理则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: SpatialTracker V2 (injecting query points with SAM 3 masks to obtain the object centroid trajectory) computes the L2 norm ‖ x ⁡ ( t ) ‖ 2 \|x(t)\|_{2} (meters) of the object worldline, and SAM 3 detects whether the object suddenly appears/disappears and the symmetry of collision rebound. A trajectory consistent with physical expectation gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialTracker V2（注入带有 SAM 3 掩码的查询点以获得物体质心轨迹）计算物体世界线的 L2 范数 ‖x(t)‖₂（米），并由 SAM 3 检测物体是否突然出现/消失以及碰撞反弹的对称性。 符合物理预期的轨迹会得到高分。

sents.en: SpatialTracker V2 (injecting query points with SAM 3 masks to obtain the object centroid trajectory) computes the L2 norm ‖ x ⁡ ( t ) ‖ 2 \|x(t)\|_{2} (meters) of the object worldline, and SAM 3 detects whether the object suddenly appears/disappears and the symmetry of collision rebound.
sents.zh: SpatialTracker V2（注入带有 SAM 3 掩码的查询点以获得物体质心轨迹）计算物体世界线的 L2 范数 ‖x(t)‖₂（米），并由 SAM 3 检测物体是否突然出现/消失以及碰撞反弹的对称性。

sents.en: A trajectory consistent with physical expectation gives a high score.
sents.zh: 符合物理预期的轨迹会得到高分。

paragraphs.en: The object centroid trajectory of SpatialTracker V2 computes velocity and the second derivative for acceleration, compared with the physical expectation for velocity error ‖ 𝐯 − 𝐯 ^ ‖ \|\mathbf{v}-\hat{\mathbf{v}}\| (m/s), with 24 fps as the time base. Smaller error is better.
paragraphs.zh: SpatialTracker V2 的物体质心轨迹通过计算速度和二阶导数得到加速度，与物理预期进行比较，得到速度误差 ‖ 𝐯 − 𝐯 ^ ‖ \|\mathbf{v}-\hat{\mathbf{v}}\| (m/s)，时间基准为 24 fps。误差越小越好。

paragraphs.en: Any6D estimates the object rotation, combined with VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry to compute the angular velocity error ‖ ω − ω ^ ‖ \|\omega-\hat{\omega}\| (rad/s), and additionally computes the coefficient of variation CV of angular velocity under free rotation (free rotation should be constant). Smaller error and CV are better.
paragraphs.zh: Any6D 估计物体的旋转，并结合 VGGT-Ω 几何信息来计算角速度误差 ‖ω − ω̂‖（rad/s），另外在自由旋转（free rotation，自由旋转时应为恒定值）情况下计算角速度的变异系数 CV。 误差和 CV 越小越好。

sents.en: Any6D estimates the object rotation, combined with VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry to compute the angular velocity error ‖ ω − ω ^ ‖ \|\omega-\hat{\omega}\| (rad/s), and additionally computes the coefficient of variation CV of angular velocity under free rotation (free rotation should be constant).
sents.zh: Any6D 估计物体的旋转，并结合 VGGT-Ω 几何信息来计算角速度误差 ‖ω − ω̂‖（rad/s），另外在自由旋转（free rotation，自由旋转时应为恒定值）情况下计算角速度的变异系数 CV。

sents.en: Smaller error and CV are better.
sents.zh: 误差和 CV 越小越好。

paragraphs.en: VFIMamba and SpatialTracker V2 reconstruct odd frames by interpolating even frames and compare with the real odd frames to obtain the interpolation error, and simultaneously compute the jerk (rate of change of acceleration) of the 3D trajectory; smaller error and jerk mean more continuous motion.
paragraphs.zh: VFIMamba 和 SpatialTracker V2 通过对偶数帧进行插值来重建奇数帧，并与真实的奇数帧进行比较以获得插值误差，同时计算三维轨迹的加加速度（jerk，加速度的变化率）；误差和加加速度越小，表示运动越连续。

paragraphs.en: SAM 3 segmentation and VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry, combined with Qwen3.8-27B semantics, check whether object identity is maintained in the “move away then move back” scene, whether the depth front-back order constitutes a legal occlusion, and count the number of tracking ID jumps. Stable ID and no illegal occlusion give a high score.
paragraphs.zh: SAM 3 分割与 VGGT- Ω \Omega 几何，结合 Qwen3.8-27B 语义，检查在“移开再移回”场景中物体身份是否保持一致，深度前后顺序是否构成合法遮挡，并统计跟踪 ID 跳变的次数。 稳定的 ID 且无不合法遮挡可获得高分。

sents.en: SAM 3 segmentation and VGGT- Ω \Omega geometry, combined with Qwen3.8-27B semantics, check whether object identity is maintained in the “move away then move back” scene, whether the depth front-back order constitutes a legal occlusion, and count the number of tracking ID jumps.
sents.zh: SAM 3 分割与 VGGT- Ω \Omega 几何，结合 Qwen3.8-27B 语义，检查在“移开再移回”场景中物体身份是否保持一致，深度前后顺序是否构成合法遮挡，并统计跟踪 ID 跳变的次数。

sents.en: Stable ID and no illegal occlusion give a high score.
sents.zh: 稳定的 ID 且无不合法遮挡可获得高分。

paragraphs.en: VGGT- Ω \Omega gives the depth point cloud, RANSAC [ 13 ] fits the support plane, and SAM 3 locates the bottom contact point of the object and checks whether the center-of-mass projection of the object falls within the support polygon; inside the polygon means stable, otherwise it may tip over.
paragraphs.zh: VGGT-Ω 给出深度点云，RANSAC [13] 拟合支撑平面，SAM 3 定位物体的底部接触点，并检查物体质心的投影是否落在支撑多边形内；位于多边形内则说明稳定，否则可能倾倒。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-specific, scale-invariant checks cover Newton’s first law, Galilean relativity, projectile motion, support contact, inclined-plane friction, sliding deceleration, bounce restitution, circular motion, and rolling. Metric scale from Depth Anything 3 is used to check acceleration against gravity. The residuals are aggregated into a score; smaller residuals are better.
paragraphs.zh: 针对特定提示词且尺度不变的检查覆盖牛顿第一定律、伽利略相对性、抛体运动、支撑接触、斜面摩擦、滑动减速、反弹恢复、圆周运动和滚动。 来自 Depth Anything 3 的度量尺度用于检验加速度与重力的关系。 这些残差被汇总为一个分数；残差越小越好。

paragraphs.en: SpatialTracker V2, SAM 3, and the metric scale of Depth Anything 3 anchor the normalized coordinates to meters. The masses are obtained from the mass ratio specified in the prompt, so that kinetic energy KE \mathrm{KE} and potential energy PE = g ​ h \mathrm{PE}=gh can be computed without ambiguity; conservative scenarios should be approximately constant, and friction-involving scenarios should decrease monotonically and not rise spontaneously. The less deviation from constant/monotonic, the better.

paragraphs.en: Table A15 gives the 1 to 5 threshold segments for each physical quantity. The mapping rule is unified: for quantities where “smaller is better” (direction ↓ \downarrow ), values successively below the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th segment threshold get 5/4/3/2 points, otherwise 1 point; for quantities where “larger is better” (direction ↑ \uparrow ), values successively above the corresponding threshold get 5/4/3/2 points. Without simulation GT (T2V/I2V setting), geometric dimensions are mapped by the above rule using the physical quantities output by specialized models (e.g., R01 depth-order accuracy, R02 normal-depth consistency, R03 normalized Chamfer), while semantic/scale/pose dimensions (R04/R06/R07/R10/R14/R25, etc.) are directly given 1 to 5 by Qwen3.8-27B; the thresholds also connect to the rationality conventions of geometric evaluation (e.g., R02 normal-depth consistency takes 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} as good), and relax the reconstruction noise baseline of specialized models (e.g., R05/R19).
paragraphs.zh: 表A15给出了每个物理量的1至5档阈值分段。 映射规则是统一的：对于“越小越好”（方向↓）的量，数值依次低于第1/2/3/4档阈值的分别得5/4/3/2分，否则得1分；对于“越大越好”（方向↑）的量，数值依次高于相应阈值的分别得5/4/3/2分。 在没有仿真GT的情况下（T2V/I2V设置），几何维度按照上述规则使用专用模型输出的物理量进行映射（例如R01深度顺序准确率、R02法向-深度一致性、R03归一化Chamfer），而语义/尺度/位姿维度（R04/R06/R07/R10/R14/R25等）则由Qwen3.8-27B直接给出1至5分；这些阈值还与几何评估的合理性约定相衔接（例如R02法向-深度一致性以15°为良好），并放宽了专用模型的重建噪声基线（例如R05/R19）。

sents.zh: 在没有仿真GT的情况下（T2V/I2V设置），几何维度按照上述规则使用专用模型输出的物理量进行映射（例如R01深度顺序准确率、R02法向-深度一致性、R03归一化Chamfer），而语义/尺度/位姿维度（R04/R06/R07/R10/R14/R25等）则由Qwen3.8-27B直接给出1至5分；这些阈值还与几何评估的合理性约定相衔接（例如R02法向-深度一致性以15°为良好），并放宽了专用模型的重建噪声基线（例如R05/R19）。

paragraphs.en: D1 to D3 do not extract numerical physical quantities, but are directly scored by specialized perception models or MLLM with 1 to 5 semantic/numerical anchors, explained per dimension below.
paragraphs.zh: D1 至 D3 不提取数值化的物理量，而是由专门的感知模型或 MLLM 直接进行评分，采用 1 至 5 的语义/数值锚点，下文将对每个维度分别说明。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the generated video contains the subject object specified by the prompt, assisted by CLIP/DINO objective reference scores; complete subject gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断生成的视频是否包含提示词所指定的主体对象，并辅以 CLIP/DINO 客观参考分数；主体完整则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B checks whether the attributes of the subject, such as color, material, and quantity, are consistent with the prompt (including color matching); if consistent, it gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 检查主体的属性（如颜色、材质和数量）是否与提示词一致（包括颜色匹配）；如果一致，则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the spatial relations between objects (above/below/left/right/front/back/containment, etc.) conform to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断物体之间的空间关系（上/下/左/右/前/后/包含关系等）是否符合提示词；符合则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the artistic/appearance style of the frame conforms to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断画面的艺术/外观风格是否符合提示词；符合则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B checks whether the negation constraints in the prompt (e.g., “no X”, “Y does not appear”) are obeyed; obeying gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 检查提示词中的否定约束（例如，“无 X”、“不出现 Y”）是否被遵守；遵守则获得高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the overall scene/environment is consistent with the scene described by the prompt; consistent gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断整体场景/环境是否与提示词描述的场景一致；一致则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the camera motion (push/pull/pan/move/orbit, etc.) conforms to the prompt; conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断镜头运动（推/拉/摇/移/环绕等）是否符合提示词；符合则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated only for I2V; aggregated from reference-image fidelity sub-indicators by DINOv3 + CLIP: IF-10a scene structure fidelity (DINOv3 feature similarity from reference image to first frame), IF-10c color/style continuity (DINOv3 Gram-matrix style distance, degraded to histogram KL divergence), IF-10d character face consistency (DINOv3 fine-feature tracking from reference image to video frame); higher fidelity gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: 仅针对 I2V 进行评估；由 DINOv3 + CLIP 聚合参考图像保真度子指标得出：IF-10a 场景结构保真度（从参考图像到首帧的 DINOv3 特征相似度）、IF-10c 色彩/风格连续性（DINOv3 Gram 矩阵风格距离，退化为直方图 KL 散度）、IF-10d 角色面部一致性（从参考图像到视频帧的 DINOv3 细粒度特征追踪）；保真度越高得分越高。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the action of the person/object conforms to the prompt (including human actions); conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断人物/物体的动作是否符合提示词（包括人类动作）；符合则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges whether the event timing conforms to the prompt (including temporal semantics); conforming gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断事件时间是否符合提示词（包括时间语义）；符合则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Adopts counterfactual action pairs: generate two versions of the video, “with action” and “without action”, for the same scene; SpatialTracker V2 tracks the 3D trajectory of the object, quantifies the causal effect (displacement amplification ratio, direction consistency), and then Qwen3.8-27B semantically verifies whether the result is reasonable; both effect and semantics reasonable give a high score.
paragraphs.zh: 采用反事实动作对：为同一场景生成「有动作」和「无动作」两个版本的视频；SpatialTracker V2 跟踪物体的 3D 轨迹，量化因果效应（位移放大比、方向一致性），然后由 Qwen3.8-27B 在语义上验证结果是否合理；效应与语义均合理则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B multiple-choice judgment plus explanatory reasonableness scoring, examining basic physical intuition (heavy objects fall, light objects float, fire rises, water flows down, shadow direction, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 多项选择题判断加解释合理性评分，考察基本的物理直觉（重物下落、轻物漂浮、火向上、水往低处流、影子方向等）；合理则给出高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the reasonableness of biological behavior (animal movement patterns, plant growth direction, human pose naturalness, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断生物行为的合理性（动物运动模式、植物生长方向、人体姿态自然度等）；合理则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B judges the reasonableness of scene logic (table and chair placement, naturalness of character interaction, daily causal consistency, etc.); reasonable gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 判断场景逻辑的合理性（桌椅摆放、人物交互的自然性、日常因果一致性等）；合理则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: DINOv3 computes the cosine similarity of subject features between adjacent frames, mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); higher similarity is better.
paragraphs.zh: DINOv3 计算相邻帧之间主体特征的余弦相似度，映射到 1 到 5（阈值见表 A15）；相似度越高越好。

paragraphs.en: FineVQ [ 11 ] (CVPR 2025, InternVL2-8B + regression head) scores the video aesthetic quality; the raw regression value is calibrated to 1 to 5 by distribution quantiles; higher score is better.
paragraphs.zh: FineVQ [ 11 ]（CVPR 2025，InternVL2-8B + 回归头）对视频美学质量进行评分；原始回归值通过分布分位数被校准到 1 到 5 之间；分数越高越好。

paragraphs.en: OpenCV/Farneback [ 3 , 12 ] optical flow computes motion acceleration smoothness max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − average acceleration / 2 ) \max(0,1-\text{average acceleration}/2) , mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); smoother is better.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCV/Farneback [3, 12] 光流法计算运动加速度平滑度 max ⁡ ( 0 , 1 − 平均加速度 / 2 ) \max(0,1-\text{平均加速度}/2)，映射到 1 到 5（阈值见表 A15）；越平滑越好。

paragraphs.en: Measured by pixel differences in static regions of adjacent frames; smaller difference is better, mapped to 1 to 5.
paragraphs.zh: 以相邻帧静态区域的像素差异来衡量；差异越小越好，映射为 1 到 5 分。

paragraphs.en: Measured by the optical flow magnitude distribution; being consistent with the dynamic expectation of the prompt gives a high score.
paragraphs.zh: 通过光流幅度分布进行衡量；与提示词的动态预期保持一致则给予高分。

paragraphs.en: CLIP computes the cosine similarity of background features between adjacent frames, mapped to 1 to 5 (threshold in Table A15 ); higher similarity is better.
paragraphs.zh: CLIP 计算相邻帧之间背景特征的余弦相似度，映射到 1 到 5（阈值见表 A15）；相似度越高越好。

paragraphs.en: Measured by Laplacian sharpness and exposure reasonableness; higher quality is better.
paragraphs.zh: 以拉普拉斯清晰度和曝光合理性来衡量；质量越高越好。

paragraphs.en: The dataset contains 600 prompt groups, each paired with T2V and I2V versions. Table A16 summarizes their composition and the share of embodied scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含 600 组提示词，每组均配有 T2V 和 I2V 两个版本。 表 A16 总结了它们的构成以及具身场景的占比。

sents.en: The dataset contains 600 prompt groups, each paired with T2V and I2V versions.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含 600 组提示词，每组均配有 T2V 和 I2V 两个版本。

sents.en: Table A16 summarizes their composition and the share of embodied scenarios.
sents.zh: 表 A16 总结了它们的构成以及具身场景的占比。

paragraphs.en: All models generate all 600 prompt groups one by one. T2V is conditioned on text, I2V is conditioned on the first-frame reference image synthesized by GPT-image-2, ensuring T2V/I2V share the same initial scene (see main text Section 3.2 ). The unified output specification is 720p, about 10 seconds (about 240 frames, 24 fps), with a fixed random seed; each model uses its officially recommended inference configuration and weights. Generated videos are uniformly resampled to the resolution and frame rate required by the evaluators before evaluation. The generation scripts, model versions, and hyperparameters will be released with the code to support third-party reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型逐一生成全部 600 个提示词组。 T2V 以文本为条件，I2V 以由 GPT-image-2 合成的首帧参考图像为条件，确保 T2V/I2V 共享相同的初始场景（见正文第 3.2 节）。 统一的输出规格为 720p、约 10 秒（约 240 帧，24 fps），并使用固定的随机种子；每个模型均采用其官方推荐的推理配置和权重。 生成的视频在评估前统一重采样为评估器所要求的分辨率和帧率。 生成脚本、模型版本和超参数将随代码一并发布，以支持第三方复现。

paragraphs.en: For reproducibility, the versions and weights of specialized models and the random seed are fixed during evaluation. The experiments cover 12 model configurations and 600 prompt groups (about 7,200 videos); the evaluation models run on a single H20 GPU (95 GB). Per-video runtime and total GPU hours vary with hardware and the evaluated dimensions. Further statistics, the runtime environment, and model-weight versions will be provided with the code release.
paragraphs.zh: 为保证可复现性，评估过程中固定了专用模型的版本与权重以及随机种子。 实验涵盖12种模型配置和600个提示词组（约7,200个视频）；评估模型在单块H20 GPU（95 GB）上运行。 单个视频的运行时间和总GPU小时数随硬件以及所评估的维度而变化。 更多统计数据、运行环境以及模型权重版本将随代码发布一同提供。
